change_note: v0.9.6 (2026-08-05): version moved in lockstep with policy_config.json (equality pin enforced by check_doc_sync check 1). NO flag or tier change in this bump -- CAT-08 v2 changed only HOW the accommodation per-night divisor is obtained (nights now derived from the folio's check-in/check-out read by both paths, replacing the employee-entered value), not WHICH flags exist. A folio stay-range disagreement REUSES the existing blocking extraction_mismatch (D3, deliberately no new flag); over_accommodation_cap is unchanged in trigger and routing. 16 blocking + 4 informational, unchanged. v0.9.5 (2026-08-03): version moved in lockstep with policy_config.json (equality pin enforced by check_doc_sync check 1). NO flag or tier change in this bump -- the only policy change was adding manager auto-approval visibility (APR-07): a notify-only weekly manager digest of auto-approved reports, declared in policy_config.json notifications block and delivered outside the scoring engine (no flag, no schema, no routing change). 16 blocking + 4 informational, unchanged. v0.9.4 (2026-07-30): new INFORMATIONAL flag field_corrected -- recorded (audit-visible only, does not force review) whenever a human amount correction is applied, with the actor role in its detail (by approver / by employee / by fin_ops) and the (AI value -> human value) pair (REV-04 label). Companion: the already-registered BLOCKING flag correction_mismatch is now actually emitted by the orchestrator (it was registered but unwired) -- fires on an EMPLOYEE amount correction whose value equals neither extraction path exactly (to the cent), per VER-03. Anti-gaming rule enforced in code and tested: a human correction never clears a pre-existing extraction_mismatch, so a receipt whose two readers disagreed still routes to a human regardless of the value typed. 16 blocking + 4 informational (up from 16 + 3). v0.9.2 (2026-07-27): new BLOCKING flag over_accommodation_cap -- fires when a hotel folio's per-night cost (folio total / nights) exceeds accommodation_cap.per_night_usd ($300 incl taxes, CAT-08); via special_approval_flags it routes manager THEN S&TP (unlike over_team_cap/over_client_cap which add S&TP only). Overage is NOT auto-excluded -- approvers decide. 16 blocking + 3 informational (up from 15 + 3). Also (no flag change): auto-approve ceiling raised $100->$200 / rolling $300->$400 in policy_config.json. v0.9.1 (2026-07-23): version moved in lockstep with policy_config.json (equality pin enforced by check_doc_sync check 1). NO flag or tier change in this bump -- the only policy change was narrowing dual_extract_agreement_fields to [amount, date] (see policy_config.json change_note). extraction_mismatch stays a blocking flag with the same trigger/effect; it now fires on amount/date disagreement only, not merchant. 15 blocking + 3 informational, unchanged. v0.9.0 (CAT-07, 2026-07-21): new blocking flag date_unverifiable -- fires on any item whose date could not be extracted by either path (OCR or LLM), across every category, forcing manager review regardless of amount or category. Companion fix, not a registry change: outside_travel_window now explicitly skips items with no date instead of evaluating them, so a no-date item is never double-flagged with a misleading travel-window verdict it was never able to check. 15 blocking + 3 informational. 2026-07-17 (doc-only, no flag/tier changes): manager_mismatch (retired_v1 entry below) confirmed permanently retired -- v2 email intake via tokenized deeplinks will not reintroduce a stated-manager field, so it will not return. non_reimbursable_item's full underlying list (minibar, in_room_entertainment, spa, gym, personal_items, alcohol in policy_config.json) confirmed as settled v1 policy, no sign-off gate for any entry -- no change to this flag's tier or effect. v0.8.0 (PRD v1.7): new blocking flag supplemental_report_after_trip_approval (T10b) -- any report for a trip that already has an approved sibling report is forced to review regardless of amount, to discourage drip-fed partial submissions (confirmed decision, 2026-07-16). over_per_diem stays informational, now additionally covering trip-linked aggregation rather than just single-report day totals. 14 blocking + 3 informational. v0.7.0 (PRD v1.4): over_per_diem re-tiered blocking -> informational (consequence now enforced deterministically via day-level auto-cap at $75); manager_mismatch retired for v1 (email intake moved to v2). 13 blocking + 3 informational.
description: Authoritative flag registry (FLG-01..03). Tiers: 'blocking' = routes to human review, disqualifies auto-approval; 'informational' = recorded and visible, consequence already enforced deterministically, does NOT disqualify auto-approval. Must stay in sync with policy_config.json 'flags' and the schema enum (FLG-02).

tiers.blocking: Human judgment can still change an outcome — forces review, kills auto-approval
tiers.informational: System already enforced the consequence — recorded and visible only

flags.trigger: Instruction-like text found in receipt images or email bodies (EXT-SEC-02)
flags.effect: Human review; verbatim text captured in injection_suspects; red-team relevant

flags.trigger: Image forgery-risk score above receipt_forgery_threshold (EXT-SEC-03)
flags.effect: Human review

flags.trigger: Cross-report/cross-employee hash match (CAP-SEC-03); submitter offered withdraw-or-proceed
flags.effect: Human review if submitter proceeds; post-approval matches go to audit path (AUD-04)

flags.trigger: Same event (merchant+date+overlapping attendees) claimed in two reports (CAT-04)
flags.effect: Human review; post-approval matches go to audit path (AUD-04)

flags.trigger: OCR and LLM paths disagree on amount/date/merchant post-normalization (EXT-04)
flags.effect: Human review

flags.trigger: Lines (incl. negative discounts) + tax + tip do not sum to total (EXT-05/05b)
flags.effect: Human review; confidence never overrides

flags.trigger: Any field confidence below extraction_confidence_min (EXT-02)
flags.effect: Human review

flags.trigger: Employee amount correction matches neither extraction path (VER-03); any amount change to fin-ops-keyed items
flags.effect: Human review with receipt alongside

flags.trigger: Daily meal sum over allowance, aggregated across trip-linked reports (CAT-02)
flags.effect: Reimbursement auto-capped at day level: min(day total, allowance) paid, excess excluded (already enforced); employee informed at receipt time; does not disqualify auto-approval

flags.trigger: T10b (v0.8.0): this report's trip_id already has at least one approved sibling report -- fires regardless of whether the per-diem cap is actually breached, since the trigger is the existence of a supplemental submission, not the dollar amount
flags.effect: Manager-level review (standard blocking-flag routing, confirmed 2026-07-16 -- not escalated to S&TP like over_team_cap/over_client_cap); discourages drip-fed partial submissions while still paying what's owed once approved

flags.trigger: Per-head cap exceeded for meal_group ($40/head), aggregated across trip (CAT-03)
flags.effect: S&TP special approval regardless of report total (APR-04)

flags.trigger: Per-head cap exceeded for client_entertainment ($50/head, applies to all attendees), aggregated across trip (CAT-03b)
flags.effect: S&TP special approval regardless of report total (APR-04)

flags.trigger: v0.9.2 (CAT-08): hotel per-night cost (folio total / nights) exceeds accommodation_cap.per_night_usd ($300 incl taxes); nights = trip length in v1
flags.effect: Routes manager THEN S&TP (special_approval_flags = [manager, stp_approver]); overage is NOT auto-excluded -- approvers decide (APR-04)

flags.trigger: Resolved item dates (EXT-11 service-date basis) outside trip window ± grace (CAT-05); items with no extractable date are skipped here, not evaluated -- see date_unverifiable
flags.effect: Human review

flags.trigger: CAT-07 (v0.9.0): neither the OCR nor the LLM path could extract a date for this item (no date printed on the receipt, or genuinely illegible). Applies uniformly across every category.
flags.effect: Human review; travel-window and per-diem-day checks are skipped for this item rather than guessed, since review is already guaranteed

flags.trigger: Clustering of totals just under auto-approval or per-diem limits (AUD-02)
flags.effect: Kills auto-approval by design; employee pattern reviewed monthly by finance

flags.trigger: Item landed in 'other' — AI-assigned or low-confidence fallback (CAT-01a)
flags.effect: Human review, never auto-approved; reviewer categorization feeds EVAL-07 labels

flags.trigger: Folio line matches non_reimbursable_line_types (EXT-09)
flags.effect: Line excluded and never paid (already enforced); shown to employee; does not disqualify auto-approval

flags.trigger: Item without receipt or qualifying snippet (CAP-04)
flags.effect: Item excluded and never paid (already enforced); frequent use caught by snippet_usage_rate anomaly signal

flags.trigger: v0.9.4 (VER-03/REV-04): a human applied an in-place correction to an extracted field (v1 build: amount). Recorded for every approver/employee/fin_ops correction, regardless of whether it also trips correction_mismatch.
flags.effect: Audit trail only -- does not force review. Detail names the actor role and the (AI value -> human value) pair; the pair is the REV-04 labeled example. human_value is authoritative and re-runs all policy checks.

retired_v1.trigger: Stated manager name differs from HR record — email channel only (CAP-SEC-02)
retired_v1.reason: Slack-only intake in v1 resolves the approver directly from the HR record; nothing to mismatch
retired_v1.reinstate_with: none -- retired permanently (confirmed 2026-07-17): v2 email intake via tokenized deeplinks will not reintroduce a stated-manager field, so this check has nothing to compare against
